notes:
Create/edit use case; saves through `set_use_cases` (upsert by id). Drawn as built; editing in the preview stays as built, also in cloud mode (ADR-010). Create mode: title "New use case", empty fields, Save = "Create use case"; a derived id that is taken steps to `<id>-2`, `-3` …, a typed one is refused.

**Dialog shell (shared by all use-case dialogs).** Native `<dialog>` opened with `showModal()` — no `role`, no `aria-modal`, no manual focus trap; `aria-labelledby` the title; `autofocus` on the first field. Header: title + id chip (`chrome-chip ref`, edit mode) + close. Body scrolls, header and footer stay. A dirty form asks before it discards (Esc, close, Cancel run through a `cancel` handler / `requestClose()`). Footer: status message left (`role="status"`), Cancel, primary save.

**Form controls are native (CHR-1097, confirmed).** Two kinds, nothing custom:
- **Closed lists → native `<select>`** (`uc-select`), plain text options: data object (first option "Data object…"), step actor ("System" + personas, names only — no avatar in the select or its options). A stored value missing from the options stays selectable as "<value> (unknown)".
- **Free text with suggestions → `<input list>` + `<datalist>`** (`chrome-field`, no chevron): Group (existing group paths), step screen (screen ids), step element (node ids of the chosen screen, ids only, up to 400). Free text is needed because a step may name a screen or node that does not exist yet or no longer exists.
Why not the drawn avatar select and the `id · <tag> "text"` node list: both need a custom listbox (or `appearance: base-select`, which Firefox does not support and which still cannot carry rich content in a `<datalist>`); the native controls give keyboard, screen-reader and autofill behaviour for free, and the persona is already shown with its avatar in the Personas chips above. Not a code change: the build already does this.

**Fields.** Title (placeholder "Map a step to a screen element") · Group (text + datalist over existing group paths; placeholder "mapping/elements") | ID ("fixed once used"; derived from the title in create mode) · Status (`uc-segmented two-second`: Draft / Ready — maturity of the spec, ADR-010; there is no priority field) | Tags ("comma separated"; placeholder "mapping, design") · Personas (removable chips with avatar + Add persona; menu "Every persona is already added." when none left) · Trigger / Goal / Outcome (textareas) · Inputs and outputs (rows: In/Out, data object select, from/to (placeholder "Use case editor"), example as `key: value` list (placeholder `status: ready`); + Input, + Output, New data object) · Steps (legend hint "· drag a handle to reorder, or focus it and press Space"; drag handle, number, actor select incl. System, action (placeholder "What happens"), actions menu (⋯, Move up / Move down: the single-pointer alternative, `usecases-edit-dialog-step-menu`), remove; the drag handle (`uc-drag-handle`, accessible name "Reorder step N, <action>") reorders the steps by pointer drag or keyboard (CHR-1103, replaces the up/down buttons; see `usecases-edit-dialog-step-drag` and `-step-keyboard`); second line: target scope `uc-segmented` Screen / Element / None, screen field (placeholder "screen"), element field (placeholder "element id"); data change rows: data object select, before (placeholder `status: draft`) → after (placeholder `status: ready`); + Data change; "+ Step") · **Variants** (last section; specified and drawn in `usecases-edit-dialog-variant`).

**Validation.** Warnings never block (same rule as drift warnings): example key not a field of the object ("label is not a field of Step."), stale screen ("This screen no longer exists. Pick another one."), element not on the screen ("<id> is not an element of <screen>."), unknown persona, variant op on a missing step. The field turns `chrome-field warning` (amber border and fill, wavy underline; built as `.chrome-field.is-warning`) and the message sits next to or below it, linked via `aria-describedby`. Footer counts them: "2 warnings. Saving is never blocked." Errors disable Save and replace the footer message (danger): at least one input and one output, each with an example; every variant needs a title and a condition; a variant step change may not add a second step with an id the flow already has (CHR-1103, `usecases-edit-dialog-variant-invalid`).

After Save: toast "Use case saved." (with warnings: the toast stays and lists them). Drawing: one In row, the Mapping input of the sample omitted; steps 2, 3 and 5 collapsed. Flows: close / Cancel / Save → `usecases-detail`; dragging a step handle → `usecases-edit-dialog-step-drag`; Space on a focused handle → `usecases-edit-dialog-step-keyboard`; step ⋯ → `usecases-edit-dialog-step-menu`.
